headline_marked: [[Claude]] Permanently Raising Weekly Limits by 25% for Paid Plans
headline: Claude Permanently Raising Weekly Limits by 25% for Paid Plans
summary: Anthropic is increasing usage limits for its Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans starting September 14th, offering a permanent 25% boost.
details: Anthropic announced a permanent increase to Claude's weekly usage limits for paid subscribers. Starting September 14th, users on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans will see their standard weekly limits raised by 25%.

Until the permanent increase takes effect, the current 50% boost will remain in place through September 13th. This temporary measure has been active for some time, providing users with additional capacity.
The change applies to seat-based Enterprise plans as well, indicating a broad effort to enhance the usability and value of Claude for its business and power-user customers.
This move suggests Anthropic's commitment to scaling its AI offerings and supporting a growing user base that relies on Claude for various tasks, from content creation to complex analysis.

headline_marked: [[Apple's first smart glasses]] to launch next year with Visual Intelligence
headline: Apple's first smart glasses to launch next year with Visual Intelligence
summary: Apple is reportedly gearing up to launch its first pair of AI-powered smart glasses as early as next year. The device will integrate Visual Intelligence technology.
details: Apple is expected to unveil its first-ever smart glasses, potentially as soon as next year. This marks a significant entry into the wearable augmented reality market for the tech giant.
The upcoming smart glasses are said to feature "Visual Intelligence," a technology that will likely enable advanced augmented reality experiences and AI-driven features.

While specific details about Visual Intelligence are scarce, it's anticipated to leverage AI to interpret and interact with the user's surroundings, offering contextual information and enhanced digital overlays.
The launch of these smart glasses could signal a new era for Apple's hardware ecosystem, potentially integrating seamlessly with existing devices like the iPhone and Apple Watch.
Further details regarding design, functionality, and specific use cases are expected to emerge as the launch date approaches.
